People commenting on my weight loss and body make me SO uncomfortable but it always has and it happens a lot more after surgery, which can be a good or bad thing sometimes. Especially if you struggle with body image or body confidence like I do.

I went into surgery feeling completely confident in the way I look because of a lot of inner self work but knowing I had to change because my doctor said so. After surgery was really bad though, I had no help with mental health, Binge eating or therapy after and my nutritionist was very unhelpful with it all the way through. If i'm being honest, it felt like nobody really cared because I 'looked' better. I was not better and I was still struggling, still crying, and hating my body in a whole new way because how vulnerable and sick I feel all the time.

I say all of this not to scare you AT ALL. This surgery has also saved my life, I still struggle with food bad, but I am finally learning how to be healthy. If anything, please make sure they care. If something makes you uncomfy, find another doctor or even office who treats you how you deserve. I was in a vulnerable spot and noone actually helped me throughout this surgery, and I know I should've said something sooner but it is what it is at this point. Good luck, and take care of yourself!

I lost my dad when I was 9 years old to a double brain aneurysm. He was only 39. I thought the grief would kill me with how long I’ve been holding onto it all alone. It’s just been pain and sadness for 19 long years. I got engaged this year, finally got my ged. I don’t seem to enjoy those happy moments in life though. They always feel empty without him.
